scope: Read-only dependency audit plus one bounded isolated cold start from a freshly materialized snapshot; no production service, database, model or workflow was modified.

production_state_at_start.reason: Host rebooted 2026-10-06T09:15:33+08:00; the ComfyUI launcher has no autostart entry, so the service was not restarted after boot.
production_state_at_start.note: Not a crash: no listener, no python process from the runtime tree, launcher state file untouched since the previous day.

findings: cv2 is provided by opencv-python 4.13.0 and opencv-contrib-python-headless 4.13.0.90; the unsatisfied 'opencv-python-headless' name does not mean cv2 is missing.
stanza is an empty namespace directory with no installed distribution; argostranslate still imports, and argostranslate is only referenced by the non-production AlekPet nodes.
aisuite (torch<2.3) and torchscale (timm==0.6.13) constrain versions that are not enforced at import; both import successfully and are referenced only by non-production code.
mediapipe 0.10.31 imports successfully and its native payload is present despite the platform-metadata warning.
No custom_nodes file imports albucore, stanza or torchscale at all.

auto_pip_install_call_sites_reachable_at.mechanism: install_requirements() inspects requirements.txt and pip-installs anything not importable
ensure_onnx_package() pip-installs onnxruntime when the import fails

import_time_side_effects.fresh_machine_risk: On a machine without these packages the first startup would install into the live interpreter; provisioning must pre-seed them so startup stays offline.
lazy_auto_install_only: comfyui_controlnet_aux node_wrappers (install_deps runs from node execution, not import)
import_time_environment_mutation: comfyui_controlnet_aux/__init__.py sets NPU_DEVICE_COUNT=0, MMCV_WITH_OPS=0 and PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1 for the whole process
ComfyUI-RMBG py/AILab_SDMatte.py blanks CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES only when SDMATTE_CPU_ONLY is explicitly enabled
startup_network_activity: ComfyUI-Danbooru-Gallery-V50-GalleryOnly async tag sync attempts a remote fetch during startup; it failed here and did not block startup

hardcoded_absolute_paths_in_production_p.locations: only offline maintenance scripts under tools/, tests/ and scripts/

isolated_cold_start.method: python -X utf8 -B -s scripts/snapshot.py materialize into a new directory, then the runtime python started ComfyUI from the materialized tree

runtime_reported.device: cuda:0 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D : cudaMallocAsync

sam3_finding.unregistered_cause: No module named 'triton'; triton is absent from the captured 443-package environment
sam3_finding.evidence: UAP统一生产工作台_v2.json references RMBG and BiRefNet but no SAM3 node name

other_known_gaps: Three Comfyroll nodes (CR Output Flow Frames, CR XY From Folder, CR XY Save Grid Image) raise while building INPUT_TYPES; other Comfyroll nodes register.
Startup is slow on a cold cache: prompt-assistant 83 s and ComfyUI-Unified-Prompt-Workbench 129 s to import, then about 247 s of library cache warm-up.

shutdown.method: process terminated after confirming an empty queue; the tree is a disposable validation copy

boundaries: Cold start was verified for module and node registration plus HTTP readiness, not for image quality or GPU inference.
Reaching HTTP readiness does not prove a full production workflow renders correctly.
The auto-install and network-sync behaviour was observed on this host where the guard packages are already present; a bare machine would behave differently.
The isolated instance ran on the same host python; a genuinely separate dependency environment was not built.
The production service is currently stopped and was deliberately not restarted.
